Honda Launches New SUV and Multiple Two-Wheeler Models in India

Honda has launched its flagship ZR-V SUV in India as a CBU unit, available in a single configuration with multiple color options and a top speed of 171 km/h. Additionally, the company has updated its portfolio by introducing 10 new bike and scooter models, targeting various market segments. These new two-wheelers, including models with features like clutchless gear shifting and electric options, will be launched gradually.
